title: ओइम्याकोन नॉर्थ पोल से भी ठंडा क्यों? 🥶
cover_text: ओइम्याकोन: *-67.7°C* में भी लोग रहते हैं

cover.prompt: A frost-covered old car with its engine running and thick white exhaust steam billowing, large in the foreground of a snowy village street, a man in a heavy fur coat and fur hat walking away past it seen from behind, low log houses with smoking chimneys behind, ice crystals glittering, bright pale blue and gold winter light, calm dark blue sky at the top, medium shot

source: Encyclopaedia Britannica (Oymyakon); Roshydromet climate records; World Meteorological Organization

fact_check.weak: Oymyakon is already a well-known viral fact, so it is only moderately non-obvious

hook_score.why: Plants the exact contradiction the ending pays off (colder than the North Pole); short and true, though it gives away part of the payoff.
hook_score.was: यहाँ लोग माइनस सड़सठ डिग्री में भी ज़िंदा रहते हैं!
